note: Configurable rules for docket-gap-tool. Rules are evaluated in order. matched rules with action=skip are excluded from final request/download list; action=review goes to review_optional; action=keep stays in final.

keep_rules.name: DIP/financing/cash collateral
keep_rules.pattern: \b(DIP|postpetition financing|cash collateral|adequate protection|superpriority|swap agreement|new lender party)\b

keep_rules.name: Claims/bar date/omnibus claim objection
keep_rules.pattern: \b(bar date|proofs? of claim|objection to claim|omnibus objection|claims objection|administrative expense claim|allowance and payment|substantial contribution claim)\b

keep_rules.name: Adversary/complaint/litigation
keep_rules.pattern: \b(adversary|complaint|declaratory judgment|motion to compel|discovery|relief from stay|automatic stay|injunction)\b

skip_rules.name: BNC/certificate of mailing
skip_rules.pattern: \b(BNC certificate|certificate of mailing|notice of filing of official transcript)\b

skip_rules.name: Service affidavit/certificate
skip_rules.pattern: \b(affidavit of service|certificate of service|supplemental certificate of service)\b

skip_rules.name: Notice/appearance/request for notice
skip_rules.pattern: \b(notice of appearance|request for notice|request for service|demand for service|notice and request for|notice of withdrawal of appearance|withdrawal of appearance)\b

skip_rules.name: Pro hac vice/admission
skip_rules.pattern: \b(pro hac vice|admission pro hac vice|admission to practice|appear and practice)\b

skip_rules.name: Hearing scheduling/admin
skip_rules.pattern: \b(hearing scheduled|hearing set|hearing cancelled|hearing continued|time of hearing rescheduled|notice of hearing|notice of motion and notice of hearing|agenda of matters|notice of agenda|notice of adjournment|motion to expedite hearing|order setting.*hearing)\b

skip_rules.name: Schedules/SOFA/admin lists
skip_rules.pattern: \b(schedule\(s\)|statement\(s\)|statement of financial affairs|schedules of assets and liabilities|creditor matrix|mailing matrix|rule 2002 list|master service list|list of creditors)\b

skip_rules.name: Deficiency/modification/no action
skip_rules.pattern: \b(notice of deficient filing|deficient filing|entry modification|no action taken|document filed in closed case)\b

skip_rules.name: Claims transfer/withdrawal/address
skip_rules.pattern: \b(withdrawal of claim|withdrawal of document|creditor change of address|debtor\(s\) change of address|claims satisfied|change of address)\b

skip_rules.name: Professional retention/fees/monthly statements
skip_rules.pattern: \b(application to employ|application for compensation|final fee application|monthly fee statement|monthly statement|certification of no objection.*fee|staffing report|retention and employment|retain and employ|retain and employment|professionals utilized in ordinary course|interim compensation|disinterestedness)\b

skip_rules.name: DIP/monthly/quarterly operating report
skip_rules.pattern: \b(monthly report of debtor|quarterly report|periodic report|post confirmation quarterly report)\b

skip_rules.name: Routine court/admin order
skip_rules.pattern: \b(order regarding electronic devices|order of designation|telephonic appearances|disposition of exhibits|exhibits destroyed|receipt of exhibits)\b

review_rules.name: Possible final-decree/closeout
review_rules.pattern: \b(final decree|motion for final decree|case closed|closing certain chapter 11 cases|case hereby closed)\b
